units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 12:22">Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 22</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="I00562"><he>טמש</he></cite>; h. text <he>טבל</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 4:6">Targ. Y. II, Lev. IV, 6</cite> <he>יִצְבּוֹעַ</he>.—Y. Sabb. II, 4ᵈ top, v. <cite ref="Q02168"><he>פְּתִילְתָּא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:6:5">Y. Taan. IV, end, 69ᶜ</cite> <he>הוה צ׳ פיסתיה וכ׳</he> dipped his bread in ashes.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:11:1">Koh. R. to VII, 11</cite> <he>הוה צ׳ חדא וכ׳</he> dipped one of his fingers in blood of a swine.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 9:5:3">Y. B. Kam. IX, 6ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>א״ל צִיבְעֵיה סומק וצַבְעֵיה אוכם</he> if he told the dyer, dye it red, and he dyed it black; <he>אילו צְבַעְתֵּיה סומק וכ׳</he> if thou hadst dyed it red, it would have been worth &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 42b:10">Men. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>הא … היכי צַבְעִיתוּ לה</he> how do you dye the purple-blue?; a. e.
Targ. O. Lev. XIII, 6 (Y. יִצְכַּע Pe.; h. text כבס). Ib. XIV, 9; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be dipped, immersed; to be soaked. Ib. XIII, 58.
